name: Itou Nanami
source: One of the Terrible Trio. Nanami is supposedly the leader of the three. She's energetic and carefree, but also a bit airheaded and impulsive. Although she's not as temperamental as the short-fused Natsuki, Nanami will often fight with her when she doesn't get her own way.
